name: Publish Widget
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/warp-widget/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-widget.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/warp-widget/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-widget.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build --workspace=@hyperlane-xyz/warp-widget
      - run: npm test --workspace=@hyperlane-xyz/warp-widget
      - run: npm run test:e2e --workspace=@hyperlane-xyz/warp-widget

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint --workspace=@hyperlane-xyz/warp-widget

  dependency-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, lint]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v4
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
          fail-on-scopes: production

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, lint, dependency-review]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build --workspace=@hyperlane-xyz/warp-widget
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: warp-widget-dist
          path: packages/warp-widget/dist/

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: warp-widget-dist
          path: dist/
      - uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
        with:
          action: 'upload'
          app_location: '/dist'
          azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN }}
          output_location: '/'
